# Services

<!-- Generated by `authinjector gen-docs` from catalogue.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every service in the public catalogue, how its key is injected, and how to call it.

### Clio (`clio`)

- Base URL: https://app.clio.com
- Key injected as: header Authorization: Bearer <key>
- Get a key: https://app.clio.com/settings/developer_applications
- Allowed:
  - GET, POST /api/v4

Call it (the broker adds the key):

```bash
authinjector call clio GET /api/v4
curl --unix-socket /run/authinjector/authinjector.sock 'http://localhost/clio/api/v4'
```

A second key for the same service is addressed as `clio:<label>`, e.g. `authinjector call clio:work ...`.

### Google Search Console (`gsc`)

- Base URL: https://searchconsole.googleapis.com
- Key injected as: header Authorization: Bearer <minted Google access token> (service account, scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly)
- Get a key: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/searchconsole.googleapis.com
- Allowed:
  - POST /webmasters/v3/sites/
  - GET /webmasters/v3/sites
  - POST /v1/urlInspection/index:inspect
  - GET /v1/sites

Call it (the broker adds the key):

```bash
authinjector call gsc GET /webmasters/v3/sites
curl --unix-socket /run/authinjector/authinjector.sock 'http://localhost/gsc/webmasters/v3/sites'
```

A second key for the same service is addressed as `gsc:<label>`, e.g. `authinjector call gsc:work ...`.
